metadata.title: सेठ सदा ठगता है, इस बार बादल ने ठगा है । Adivasi farmers and web of Moneylenders । Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
The Adivasi farmer in the Nimad region of Madhya Pradesh grows lentils, soyabean and cotton. These adivasi farmers invest their entire earnings into their crops, and take the great risk to losing everything, every year.

The risk is manifold because there is no irrigation facility for their farms, and they are  completely dependent on the monsoon. This year has brought a lot of anxiety for then, as the rains were delayed, increasing the danger of them losing their crop and all their money.

#Adivasi_Kisan #Madhya_Pradesh #Ground_Report
